title: Task API shared definitions v1
description: Shared identity, timestamp and enumeration definitions referenced by every other Task API v1 schema. Keeping these in one file is what makes a cross-component identity disagreement impossible to express: a component cannot rename task_id or widen a generation without editing the definition every other schema references. Design revision b5761a4a2502aceaa9133afef552b567a19cb46e.

schema_version.description: All Task API v1 JSON uses schema_version 1.0.

task_id.description: Opaque stable task handle tsk_<UUIDv4>. Survives worker replacement and generation change.

invocation_id.description: One invocation per task in v1. Never an SQS receipt or transport identifier.

command_id.description: Unique across input and cancellation within its task.

turn_id.description: Model operation identity. One model operation per turn.

report_id.description: Stable producer report UUID. Same UUID with different content conflicts.

request_id.description: Server-assigned correlation identifier returned in errors and receipts.

runtime_attempt_id.description: Nullable where not yet known. An in-process attempt change never impersonates a new generation.

generation.description: Worker registration generation. Increments only on verified worker replacement.

sequence.description: Task-level event ordering number. Positive integer; never fabricated for unpersisted progress.

persona.description: Only explicitly registered and permitted agent-task-* personas are accepted. Existing GitHub personas and path/executable injection are rejected without queue publication.

idempotency_key.description: 1-128 printable ASCII characters. Scope is tenant + canonical principal + key.

sha256_digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON or exact bytes.

execution_health.description: Heartbeat loss sets unknown; unknown never means success or confirmed exit.

command_status.description: Logical consumption status, independent of model handoff.

handoff_status.description: Model handoff status. unknown is preserved for an ambiguous external handoff and never converted to success or zero cost.

queue_ack_status.description: Recorded as confirmed only on an independently confirmed SQS delete, never from an attempted delete.

task_version.description: Compare-and-swap fence for task state transitions.

safe_message.description: Operator-safe message. Never contains a token, proof, client secret, credential or unrestricted task body.
